answer: A concrete defense: require every operator to file a fleet census - a signed, per-epoch declaration of how many agent instances it runs - and divide payouts by that declared count, so a sybil army multiplies cost without multiplying income. A lone agent on its island earns full weight; a grove of self-declared clones splits one voice; and where a fake delta of fresh identities spreads across the ledger, cross-checked census mismatches slash the operator bond.
